snippet.title: Art Strikers // SAGE 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
SAGE Booth ► https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/art-strikers-2025-demo.2538/
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3384330/Art_Strikers/

Art Strikers (formerly known as "Art Attack") is a 2D side scrolling shoot-em-up with gameplay inspired by Gradius, Silver Surfer, and Cuphead. The aesthetic of each level is based on a different artist or art movement from history. This demo in an updated version from last year that contains the first two levels in its entirety with every placeholder sprite replaced with finalized art.​
​
Developed by 
Friendly Fire Software
